research.notes: UBC is sprayed airless (robot, flat-stream/airless nozzles e.g. Dürr EcoJetAC/EcoJetSE on EcoGun2 3D) after ED, before sealer oven. No public source for RSU-230/GVH-170. Local context: JV Uz-Dongju Paint Co (Asaka/Uzbekistan; UzAvtosanoat + Korean DongJu/KION) was set up to supply UzAuto with pretreatment chemicals (3750 t/yr), sealants (1250 t/yr) and automotive paints, and its 2024 privatisation required keeping GM-standard compliance. It is a plausible local maker/distributor of the RSB/RSU sealers and possibly pretreatment/ED materials (unconfirmed; uzdongju.uz not reachable from this session). | round2_A: RSU-230/GVH-170 not found. Graco AL automatic airless gun manual 308813 only on third-party manualsdir.com (HTML). | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Graco XL10000/XL6500 air-motor manuals are pump drive components (weak passports; kept). 3A7301ES is confirmed by search as the Spanish King XL10K pump/spray package manual (rev K), fine. The duerr endless-dosing datasheet is a battery-gluing doc and the German duplicate of the round-1 EN sheet. The Atlas Copco LASD leaflet is a sound-deadener dispensing doc, adjacent class only. TEROSON PV 3145 TDS: not found by search (searches for 'TEROSON PV 3145' only return PV 3046, a PVC seam sealer). The URL follows the valid Henkel TDX pattern but is UNVERIFIED and may not exist; check it before use. | Round3: TEROSON PV 3145 URL removed (product not found in any search; URL likely constructed). | round4_fix: Same Graco fixes as id 4; Huntsman Euretek guide unrecoverable. | round4_paint evidence: uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. SEC EX-99.1 (PPG press release 2006-06-29): PPG owned 50% of Dongju Industrial since 1985 and bought the remaining 50% in 2006 (Dongju = Korean automotive OEM/refinish/industrial coatings maker, plants Chon Ahn and Busan; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/79879/000119312506138741/dex991.htm) - i.e. today's PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd., Busan. No public record of RSB-430, RSU-230, GVH-403U, GVH-170, UBS COAT or P8201 on uzdongju.uz (sealant category empty), PPG public SDS portal (codes/names searched) or web search. The R-prefix of RSB/RSU may follow the DongJu 'Royal' coding (R?T thinners) - inference only. | round4_paint: Round4: no exact sealer/PVC document found. uzdongju.uz automotive 'Sealants' category lists 0 products; PPG portal has no RSB/RSU/GVH/P8201 codes; Noroo (named by Uz-DongJu as main supplier) sites are unreachable from this session (noroopaint.com tunnel closed) - a Noroo MSDS search should be tried from an open network. research.notes: Shares spec GVH-170 with item 5, so it is likely an approved second source or different packaging of the same underbody PVC. No public exact doc. Local context: JV Uz-Dongju Paint Co (Asaka/Uzbekistan; UzAvtosanoat + Korean DongJu/KION) was set up to supply UzAuto with pretreatment chemicals (3750 t/yr), sealants (1250 t/yr) and automotive paints, and its 2024 privatisation required keeping GM-standard compliance. It is a plausible local maker/distributor of the RSB/RSU sealers and possibly pretreatment/ED materials (unconfirmed; uzdongju.uz not reachable from this session). | round2_A: Same spec GVH-170 as id 5; same equivalent docs. No exact doc. | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Graco XL10000/XL6500 air-motor manuals are pump drive components (weak passports; kept). 3A7301ES is confirmed by search as the Spanish King XL10K pump/spray package manual (rev K), fine. The duerr endless-dosing datasheet is a battery-gluing doc and the German duplicate of the round-1 EN sheet. The Atlas Copco LASD leaflet is a sound-deadener dispensing doc, adjacent class only. TEROSON PV 3145 TDS: not found by search (searches for 'TEROSON PV 3145' only return PV 3046, a PVC seam sealer). The URL follows the valid Henkel TDX pattern but is UNVERIFIED and may not exist; check it before use. | Round3: TEROSON PV 3145 URL removed (product not found in any search; URL likely constructed). | round4_fix: Same Graco fixes as id 4; Huntsman Euretek guide unrecoverable. | round4_paint evidence: uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. SEC EX-99.1 (PPG press release 2006-06-29): PPG owned 50% of Dongju Industrial since 1985 and bought the remaining 50% in 2006 (Dongju = Korean automotive OEM/refinish/industrial coatings maker, plants Chon Ahn and Busan; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/79879/000119312506138741/dex991.htm) - i.e. today's PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd., Busan. No public record of RSB-430, RSU-230, GVH-403U, GVH-170, UBS COAT or P8201 on uzdongju.uz (sealant category empty), PPG public SDS portal (codes/names searched) or web search. The R-prefix of RSB/RSU may follow the DongJu 'Royal' coding (R?T thinners) - inference only. | round4_paint: Round4: no exact sealer/PVC document found. uzdongju.uz automotive 'Sealants' category lists 0 products; PPG portal has no RSB/RSU/GVH/P8201 codes; Noroo (named by Uz-DongJu as main supplier) sites are unreachable from this session (noroopaint.com tunnel closed) - a Noroo MSDS search should be tried from an open network. Added verified current Graco manuals (dead 334644EN-D replaced).

research.notes: Anti-chip PVC is robot/airless-sprayed on sills/wheel arches (wet-on-wet before primer). Spec 'P8201' not found publicly. Source row was duplicated. Local context: JV Uz-Dongju Paint Co (Asaka/Uzbekistan; UzAvtosanoat + Korean DongJu/KION) was set up to supply UzAuto with pretreatment chemicals (3750 t/yr), sealants (1250 t/yr) and automotive paints, and its 2024 privatisation required keeping GM-standard compliance. It is a plausible local maker/distributor of the RSB/RSU sealers and possibly pretreatment/ED materials (unconfirmed; uzdongju.uz not reachable from this session). | REVIEW: Sikagard-6682 removed (water-based sound deadener, not PVC anti-chip). | round2_A: P8201 not found. No PVC-plastisol-specific anti-chip TDS found (3M/Sika results are rubber/alkyd refinish, excluded). | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Graco XL10000/XL6500 air-motor manuals are pump drive components (weak passports; kept). 3A7301ES is confirmed by search as the Spanish King XL10K pump/spray package manual (rev K), fine. The duerr endless-dosing datasheet is a battery-gluing doc and the German duplicate of the round-1 EN sheet. The Atlas Copco LASD leaflet is a sound-deadener dispensing doc, adjacent class only. TEROSON PV 3145 TDS: not found by search (searches for 'TEROSON PV 3145' only return PV 3046, a PVC seam sealer). The URL follows the valid Henkel TDX pattern but is UNVERIFIED and may not exist; check it before use. | Round3: TEROSON PV 3145 URL removed (product not found in any search; URL likely constructed). | round4_fix: Same Graco fixes as id 4. | round4_paint evidence: uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. SEC EX-99.1 (PPG press release 2006-06-29): PPG owned 50% of Dongju Industrial since 1985 and bought the remaining 50% in 2006 (Dongju = Korean automotive OEM/refinish/industrial coatings maker, plants Chon Ahn and Busan; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/79879/000119312506138741/dex991.htm) - i.e. today's PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd., Busan. No public record of RSB-430, RSU-230, GVH-403U, GVH-170, UBS COAT or P8201 on uzdongju.uz (sealant category empty), PPG public SDS portal (codes/names searched) or web search. The R-prefix of RSB/RSU may follow the DongJu 'Royal' coding (R?T thinners) - inference only. | round4_paint: Round4: no exact sealer/PVC document found. uzdongju.uz automotive 'Sealants' category lists 0 products; PPG portal has no RSB/RSU/GVH/P8201 codes; Noroo (named by Uz-DongJu as main supplier) sites are unreachable from this session (noroopaint.com tunnel closed) - a Noroo MSDS search should be tried from an open network. Added verified current Graco manuals (dead 334644EN-D replaced).

research.notes: CR-100 and spec KR-APC-707U/742U not found publicly. Best hypotheses: (a) Uz-DongJu Paint (Asaka-based JV, est. 1995/96, listed among UzAuto main suppliers; 2024 buyer pledged GM-standard compliance) producing to GM Korea 'KR' specs, possibly under Korean licence; (b) KCC Corporation (largest Korean OEM paint maker, GM Korea supplier; signed 2025 Uzbek automotive-paint plant agreement). No PDF of the exact product found. KCC US4000 (refinish 2K primer surfacer) is only a loose family equivalent. Only plant-specific evidence found: 2023 Asaka modernization (uzdaily/kun.uz) mentions FANUC robots in press shop and maintenance of 'robotic systems' in the paint shop without naming vendors; GM Korea Changwon paint shop (2021) uses 78 Dürr robots. Equipment below is REPRESENTATIVE, not confirmed for Asaka. | round2_B evidence: Daryo.uz (2024-06-22, https://daryo.uz/en/2024/06/22/uzbekistans-sama-sell50-stake-ofuz-dongju-paint-for19bn/): Uz-DongJu Paint's main production facility is in Asaka; the buyer of the 50% state stake pledged to keep product compliance with General Motors standards and OEM requirements; products under 'Royal Paint' brand incl. paints, varnishes, sealants and car-body chemicals. GoldenPages.uz (https://www.goldenpages.uz/en/company/?Id=9727) lists automotive paints, primers and urethane varnishes, 'plant for production of automotive... paints... for GM'. Strengthens Uz-DongJu as the supplier; Korean technology partner still unconfirmed. Exact products (CR-100, HITEC 2000, KR- thinners) not found publicly. | round2_B: 'CR-100' not found under any manufacturer (EN/KO searches). No public OEM 1K solventborne surfacer TDS/SDS from PPG/BASF/Axalta/KCC located; OEM products are distributed under restricted access. No exact doc. Search budget exhausted before Dürr/ABB mixing-room/solvent recovery searches could be completed. | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Uz-DongJu Paint JV as UzAuto paint supplier: CONFIRMED by search (uzavtosanoat.uz lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto Motors suppliers; Daryo 2024 says the buyer is committed to GM standards/OEM requirements; Golden Pages calls it a paint plant serving GM). That it makes these specific products is still inference, so manufacturer_confidence 'medium' is right, and 'low' for the thinners. Korean technology partner (KCC/Noroo) not confirmed. KCC UU3000 is a 2K refinish primer-surfacer and the Hoffmann guide is a waterborne formulation, while CR-100 is probably a solvent-borne 1K bake surfacer. Both are weak class equivalents (labelled 'equivalent', OK). GMW3002 GlobalSpec and the ABB RB1000i page are HTML (file null), fine. EcoRP E043i datasheet and robot-stations brochure (orch): plausible official durr.com paths, but the filename was not found in search results. RB1000-SSD (solvent-borne standard) is the right atomizer variant. | round4_fix: ABB RB1000i presentation re-located via ABB Library API; RB1000i data sheet added. | round4_paint evidence: uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. SEC EX-99.1 (PPG press release 2006-06-29): PPG owned 50% of Dongju Industrial since 1985 and bought the remaining 50% in 2006 (Dongju = Korean automotive OEM/refinish/industrial coatings maker, plants Chon Ahn and Busan; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/79879/000119312506138741/dex991.htm) - i.e. today's PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd., Busan. Uz-DongJu TDS 'AHT-000 BASE COAT MEDIUM SOLID (METALLIC, MICA)' (https://uzdongju.uz/uploads/docs/products/top-metallic-base_tds.pdf, RU, 2 p., created 2017-06-22): polyester-melamine 2C1B base coat for car bodies; thinner 'RHT-031 (Top Metallic Thinner)' 30-40 wt%; clear 'CLEAR VARNISH (ABT-000)'; applied wet-on-wet over ED and 'APU' primer surfacer; tool cleaning 'RCT-095A (New Cleaning Thinner)'; cure with clear 130 C x 30 min; Behr bells 24,000 rpm, 70-90 kV. The plant's spec codes belong to the same DongJu/PPG Korea 'KR-' code system (see thinners). 'CR-100' as a primer name and code KR-APC-707U/742U are not public (PPG's 'CR-100' is an unrelated cathodic ED emulsion). | round4_paint: Round4: no exact primer-surfacer document found (uzdongju.uz 'Primers' category lists 0 products; PPG portal has no KR-APC codes). Manufacturer evidence upgraded from verified Uz-DongJu and PPG/SEC sources.

research.notes: CR-100 and spec KR-APC-707U/742U not found publicly. Best hypotheses: (a) Uz-DongJu Paint (Asaka-based JV, est. 1995/96, listed among UzAuto main suppliers; 2024 buyer pledged GM-standard compliance) producing to GM Korea 'KR' specs, possibly under Korean licence; (b) KCC Corporation (largest Korean OEM paint maker, GM Korea supplier; signed 2025 Uzbek automotive-paint plant agreement). No PDF of the exact product found. KCC US4000 (refinish 2K primer surfacer) is only a loose family equivalent. Only plant-specific evidence found: 2023 Asaka modernization (uzdaily/kun.uz) mentions FANUC robots in press shop and maintenance of 'robotic systems' in the paint shop without naming vendors; GM Korea Changwon paint shop (2021) uses 78 Dürr robots. Equipment below is REPRESENTATIVE, not confirmed for Asaka. | round2_B evidence: Daryo.uz (2024-06-22, https://daryo.uz/en/2024/06/22/uzbekistans-sama-sell50-stake-ofuz-dongju-paint-for19bn/): Uz-DongJu Paint's main production facility is in Asaka; the buyer of the 50% state stake pledged to keep product compliance with General Motors standards and OEM requirements; products under 'Royal Paint' brand incl. paints, varnishes, sealants and car-body chemicals. GoldenPages.uz (https://www.goldenpages.uz/en/company/?Id=9727) lists automotive paints, primers and urethane varnishes, 'plant for production of automotive... paints... for GM'. Strengthens Uz-DongJu as the supplier; Korean technology partner still unconfirmed. Exact products (CR-100, HITEC 2000, KR- thinners) not found publicly. | round2_B: Same as id 8. | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Uz-DongJu Paint JV as UzAuto paint supplier: CONFIRMED by search (uzavtosanoat.uz lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto Motors suppliers; Daryo 2024 says the buyer is committed to GM standards/OEM requirements; Golden Pages calls it a paint plant serving GM). That it makes these specific products is still inference, so manufacturer_confidence 'medium' is right, and 'low' for the thinners. Korean technology partner (KCC/Noroo) not confirmed. KCC UU3000 is a 2K refinish primer-surfacer and the Hoffmann guide is a waterborne formulation, while CR-100 is probably a solvent-borne 1K bake surfacer. Both are weak class equivalents (labelled 'equivalent', OK). GMW3002 GlobalSpec and the ABB RB1000i page are HTML (file null), fine. EcoRP E043i datasheet and robot-stations brochure (orch): plausible official durr.com paths, but the filename was not found in search results. RB1000-SSD (solvent-borne standard) is the right atomizer variant. | round4_fix: ABB RB1000i presentation re-located via ABB Library API; RB1000i data sheet added. | round4_paint evidence: uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. SEC EX-99.1 (PPG press release 2006-06-29): PPG owned 50% of Dongju Industrial since 1985 and bought the remaining 50% in 2006 (Dongju = Korean automotive OEM/refinish/industrial coatings maker, plants Chon Ahn and Busan; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/79879/000119312506138741/dex991.htm) - i.e. today's PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd., Busan. Uz-DongJu TDS 'AHT-000 BASE COAT MEDIUM SOLID (METALLIC, MICA)' (https://uzdongju.uz/uploads/docs/products/top-metallic-base_tds.pdf, RU, 2 p., created 2017-06-22): polyester-melamine 2C1B base coat for car bodies; thinner 'RHT-031 (Top Metallic Thinner)' 30-40 wt%; clear 'CLEAR VARNISH (ABT-000)'; applied wet-on-wet over ED and 'APU' primer surfacer; tool cleaning 'RCT-095A (New Cleaning Thinner)'; cure with clear 130 C x 30 min; Behr bells 24,000 rpm, 70-90 kV. The plant's spec codes belong to the same DongJu/PPG Korea 'KR-' code system (see thinners). 'CR-100' as a primer name and code KR-APC-707U/742U are not public (PPG's 'CR-100' is an unrelated cathodic ED emulsion). | round4_paint: Round4: no exact primer-surfacer document found (uzdongju.uz 'Primers' category lists 0 products; PPG portal has no KR-APC codes). Manufacturer evidence upgraded from verified Uz-DongJu and PPG/SEC sources.

All WebFetch attempts failed: hosts durr.com, library.e.abb.com, uzdongju.uz, daryo.uz, spot.uz not in the session's allowed network, so nothing is verified. Equipment is representative only. | round2_C evidence: uzavtosanoat.uz UzAuto Motors page lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto suppliers (https://uzavtosanoat.uz/en/company/ao-uzauto-motors); Daryo 2024-06-22 (https://daryo.uz/en/2024/06/22/uzbekistans-sama-sell50-stake-ofuz-dongju-paint-for19bn/) says JV founded 1995, makes car paints/sealants/body chemicals under 'Royal Paint', main plant in Asaka, buyer committed to keep products compliant with General Motors standards and OEM requirements; spot.uz 2022-08-26 (https://www.spot.uz/ru/2022/08/26/uzdongju/) on the stake tender. KCC: only a July 2025 cooperation agreement for a planned 335 t/yr automotive paint plant (https://invest.miit.uz/en/posts/the-investment-promotion-agency-and-kcc-corporation-signed-a-cooperation-agreement-on-an-automotive-paint-production-project) - too small/too recent to be the historic basecoat supplier. No PDF document from Uz-DongJu found (site uzdongju.uz per yellowpages.uz, not indexed). | round2_C: Web search budget ran out before Duerr EcoRP E043i / ABB RB1000 datasheet and Chevrolet brochure-PDF searches could run; no new equipment docs. No OEM-line solvent-borne basecoat SDS/TDS PDF from KCC, Noroo, BASF, Axalta, PPG or Kansai is publicly indexed (KCC technical search center https://www.kccworld.co.kr/eng/technical/searchCenter.do lists MSDS titles but no direct PDFs seen). Per-colour formula/colour-information PDFs from PPG/Axalta/BASF were not found for any code; only retailer HTML pages (paintscratch, drcolorchip, automotivetouchup). Red-E or Not Red also listed as GM/Chevrolet USA 431B (nonpaints.com) and GX8 (paintscratch); GL8 still unresolved. | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Uz-DongJu Paint JV as UzAuto paint supplier: CONFIRMED by search (uzavtosanoat.uz lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto Motors suppliers; Daryo 2024 says the buyer is committed to GM standards/OEM requirements; Golden Pages calls it a paint plant serving GM). That it makes these specific products is still inference, so manufacturer_confidence 'medium' is right, and 'low' for the thinners. Korean technology partner (KCC/Noroo) not confirmed. Lesonal Basecoat SB TDS confirmed by search (AkzoNobel host, 09/12/2019, NA refinish PST). It and Centari 600 are refinish solvent-borne proxies, correctly labelled 'equivalent'. The PPG/BASF OEM basecoat HTML pages are fine as class references. | round4_fix: ABB RB1000i presentation re-located via ABB Library API; RB1000i data sheet added. Glasurit 100-M 998 SDS re-issued under new file id (GB-EN v5.0, 2026) - NOTE it is a waterborne refinish mixing base (catalog said solvent-borne); refinish proxy only. | round4_paint evidence: uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. Equipment is representative only. | round2_C evidence: uzavtosanoat.uz UzAuto Motors page lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto suppliers (https://uzavtosanoat.uz/en/company/ao-uzauto-motors); Daryo 2024-06-22 (https://daryo.uz/en/2024/06/22/uzbekistans-sama-sell50-stake-ofuz-dongju-paint-for19bn/) says JV founded 1995, makes car paints/sealants/body chemicals under 'Royal Paint', main plant in Asaka, buyer committed to keep products compliant with General Motors standards and OEM requirements; spot.uz 2022-08-26 (https://www.spot.uz/ru/2022/08/26/uzdongju/) on the stake tender. KCC: only a July 2025 cooperation agreement for a planned 335 t/yr automotive paint plant (https://invest.miit.uz/en/posts/the-investment-promotion-agency-and-kcc-corporation-signed-a-cooperation-agreement-on-an-automotive-paint-production-project) - too small/too recent to be the historic basecoat supplier. That it makes these specific products is still inference, so manufacturer_confidence 'medium' is right, and 'low' for the thinners. Korean technology partner (KCC/Noroo) not confirmed. Lesonal Basecoat SB TDS confirmed by search (AkzoNobel host, 09/12/2019, NA refinish PST). It and Centari 600 are refinish solvent-borne proxies, correctly labelled 'equivalent'. The PPG/BASF OEM basecoat HTML pages are fine as class references. | round4_fix: ABB RB1000i presentation re-located via ABB Library API; RB1000i data sheet added. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. No public TDS/SDS found for exact thinner. Same SAP/spec as item 26 (cleaning thinner); likely one solvent used both as reducer and flush. Only plant-specific evidence found: 2023 Asaka modernization (uzdaily/kun.uz) mentions FANUC robots in press shop and maintenance of 'robotic systems' in the paint shop without naming vendors; GM Korea Changwon paint shop (2021) uses 78 Dürr robots. Strengthens Uz-DongJu as the supplier; Korean technology partner still unconfirmed. Exact products (CR-100, HITEC 2000, KR- thinners) not found publicly. | round2_B: Same SAP/spec as id 26. No OEM basecoat reducer SDS public. Equivalents only (Korean solventborne thinner MSDS). | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Uz-DongJu Paint JV as UzAuto paint supplier: CONFIRMED by search (uzavtosanoat.uz lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto Motors suppliers; Daryo 2024 says the buyer is committed to GM standards/OEM requirements; Golden Pages calls it a paint plant serving GM). That it makes these specific products is still inference, so manufacturer_confidence 'medium' is right, and 'low' for the thinners. Korean technology partner (KCC/Noroo) not confirmed. KCC enamel thinner 012 (third-party host) is a general-industrial thinner, a weak equivalent. The koreascience 2006 paper is OK as 'paper' type only. | round4_paint evidence: Exact code match: plant spec KR-RHT-031 = 'RHT-031 (Top Metallic Thinner)' named as the reducer (30-40 wt%) in Uz-DongJu's own AHT-000 base-coat TDS. Uz-DongJu TDS 'AHT-000 BASE COAT MEDIUM SOLID (METALLIC, MICA)' (https://uzdongju.uz/uploads/docs/products/top-metallic-base_tds.pdf, RU, 2 p., created 2017-06-22): polyester-melamine 2C1B base coat for car bodies; thinner 'RHT-031 (Top Metallic Thinner)' 30-40 wt%; clear 'CLEAR VARNISH (ABT-000)'; applied wet-on-wet over ED and 'APU' primer surfacer; tool cleaning 'RCT-095A (New Cleaning Thinner)'; cure with clear 130 C x 30 min; Behr bells 24,000 rpm, 70-90 kV. PPG public SDS portal (https://buyat.ppg.com/EHSDocumentManagerPublic/documentSearch.aspx) shows PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd. thinner codes 'KR-R?T-nnn' incl. 'ROYAL' names (ROYAL THINNER RBT-010D = KR-RBT-010D; ROYALMEL THINNER = KR-RAT-024; ROYALTHANE THINNER = KR-RUT-085; ROYALPOX THINNER = KR-RET-045; ESTA CLEANING THINNER (G.I.) = KR-RCT-095GI), the same code system as the plant specs KR-RHT-031/051, KR-RBT-029 and as Uz-DongJu's RHT-031/RCT-095A ('Royal' = DongJu brand, cf. Uz-DongJu 'ROYAL PAINT'). PPG Korea also issues SDS for 'DJ-' intermix pastes, resins and solvents shipped to Uzbekistan (codes .../UZ/...), indicating that Uz-DongJu formulates locally from PPG Korea intermediates. uzdongju.uz/en/pages/about-us.html (fetched 2026-10-29): JV founded 1995 by DongJu Industrial Co. (KR) and UzAvtoSanoat, opened 1999; capacity 3,750 t/yr metal pretreatment products, 1,250 t/yr sealant, 2,500 t/yr automotive paints; 'main suppliers are NOROO Paint & Coatings Co., Ltd. and PPG Industries Korea Inc.'; customers include JSC UzAuto Motors. SEC EX-99.1 (PPG press release 2006-06-29): PPG owned 50% of Dongju Industrial since 1985 and bought the remaining 50% in 2006 (Dongju = Korean automotive OEM/refinish/industrial coatings maker, plants Chon Ahn and Busan; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/79879/000119312506138741/dex991.htm) - i.e. today's PPG Industries (Korea) Ltd., Busan. | round4_paint: Round4: identity of KR-RHT-031 resolved (Royal 'Top Metallic Thinner'); no own SDS/TDS public. Reference TDS added with explicit caveat.

No public evidence found of the actual filling equipment at UzAuto Motors Asaka; equipment is representative. Dürr Somac is the market leader in final-assembly fluid filling (approx. 2,900 stations in 44 countries) and is standard at GM plants; product pages (not PDFs) seen in search: durr.com/en/products/final-assembly/filling-technology/{line-filling-stations, compact-filling-stations, automated-filling-stations, filling-adapter} and .../nextassembly-of-the-future/proline-cube-filling-station. No public document names 'DX-COOL'. | round2_D: Product page FELIX Carbox G12+: https://antifreezefelix.ru/antifreeze/felix-carbox (HTML). TDS (antifreezefelix.ru) is labelled 'exact' and should be 'equivalent' (candidate). DX-COOL to Carbox mapping is unproven, and DX-COOL most likely means a DEX-COOL-type (GM 6277M) coolant. research.notes: Same fluid family as id 28. Automatic transaxles (e.g. GM 6T40 built at GM Powertrain Uzbekistan) are typically filled at the powertrain plant. No public evidence found of the actual filling equipment at UzAuto Motors Asaka; equipment is representative. Dürr Somac is the market leader in final-assembly fluid filling (approx. 2,900 stations in 44 countries) and is standard at GM plants; product pages (not PDFs) seen in search: durr.com/en/products/final-assembly/filling-technology/{line-filling-stations, compact-filling-stations, automated-filling-stations, filling-adapter} and .../nextassembly-of-the-future/proline-cube-filling-station. No 'EcoFill' product name was found on Dürr sources; current names are Somac ProLine Cube, ProLine, Compact X/CompStart, BlueStart, G4 Blue adapters. | REVIEW: GMN10060 (DEXRON-VI) superseded by GMW16444. | round2_D: Dexron-VI (automatic transmission). GM-hosted SDS found (ACDelco Australia). No SDS found for GM 19355342/88865601 specifically; sdsmanager.com hosts ACDelco Dexron-VI ATF (ExxonMobil, rev 2020-10-20) as HTML page: https://sdsmanager.com/safety-data-sheet/exxon-mobil-corporation-acdelco-dexron-vi-atf-en/. Actual blender for UzAuto unknown. | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Dexron-VI SDS set is fine, all labelled equivalent. The ACDelco AU LQ9RG URL was not found by name in search (an ACDelco AU DEXRON-VI SDS exists, Infosafe 1EVFM on torqueking.com). The webflow-hosted SDS has an odd but stable CDN URL. Twin Engineers fluid-filling brochure (alt vendor) was not found by filename in search. Its relevance is low (no evidence of use at UzAuto); keep as class reference only. | round4_fix: Same fixes as id 28. | round4_assembly: GM's official public SDS portal (gmparts.com -> apps.spheracloud.net 'SEARCH SAFETY DATA SHEETS') lists several ACDelco DEXRON VI ATF SDS from different licensed blenders: SK lubricants Americas (88865601, 2020), Phillips 66 (code 829783, P/N 88865549/88865550/88865618/88865765, issued 01-Mar-2023, https://apps.spheracloud.net/Pdf/4347058_1_578371061.pdf, verified) and Shell Lubricants Egypt (19434708, 2023). Which blender supplies UzAuto's 200 L drums (automatic transmission fluid) is still unknown, so manufacturer stays 'licensed Dexron-VI blender'. GM part 19417575 was not found in the GM SDS index.

research.notes: No GM spec for wheel pilot lubricant found publicly. | round2_E evidence: GM bulletin 17-NA-235 specifies ACDelco M-77 paste (P/N 19356408 = MOLYKOTE M-77) for hub bearing surfaces; no public GM spec for wheel pilot hole lubricant found. | round2_E: Product unidentified; Liqui Moly Wheel Hub Paste (HTML page only) is an aftermarket analogue. Other Graco manual numbers seen (no URL): 307882 (15:1 Fire-Ball), 309869 (repair). | round3_review: REVIEW round3: MOLYKOTE M-77 for wheel pilot: WEAK. NHTSA TSB 17-NA-235 exists and specifies ACDelco M-77 (P/N 19356408), but on the hub BEARING surface of the Chevrolet City Express (a Nissan-built van), not the wheel pilot bore, and it is a service fix, not a plant spec. GM service notes only say 'GM-recommended grease' at the pilot, and another GM TSB uses MOLYKOTE Cu-7439 Plus on the hub spigot. So the M-77 TDS is an 'equivalent' candidate only (label OK); manufacturer stays unknown. The Graco Fire-Ball 300 manuals are drum pumps, not a fit for a 15 kg pail (weak). | round4_fix: Graco 308883 -> English edition rev Y (308883EN-Y); 309868DE-A same file on www.graco.com (English 309868EN-B already in catalog). | round4_assembly: Lubricant identity still unknown; no GM/Chevrolet document tying a specific grease to the wheel pilot hole was found (GM wheel-bearing grease P/N 1051344 appears in GM workshop snippets but not for the pilot bore - unconfirmed).
